page_title: NIC 3-2 LYO | Nice v Lyon 18/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) decides to take on the shot from mid-range after a rebound, but he fails to connect properly with the ball and the effort sails harmlessly wide of the left post.
90+8' Lyon fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
90+6' The yellow card is received by Moussa Niakhate (Lyon).
90+5' 3 - 2 Pavel Sulc (Lyon) rises high to beat the goalkeeper with a perfect header. He heads the ball inside the left post.
90+5' Lyon quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+4' Lyon win a corner.
90+4' Lyon fail to score from a corner as Yehvann Diouf (Nice) leaps to collect the ball.
90+4' Lyon fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air. The ball goes out for a corner. Lyon can continue in their attacking effort.
90+3' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
90+1' Nice take a short corner kick.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lyon comes to nothing.

86' Tanner Tessmann (Lyon) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
82' Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) strikes a bullet of a shot towards goal from distance and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
82' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
81' A corner kick by Lyon is thwarted by the well prepared Yehvann Diouf (Nice).
79' Afonso Moreira (Lyon) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
77' Here comes a substitution. Moussa Niakhate (Lyon) is brought on as a substitute for Clinton Mata.
77' Jorge Maciel has decided to substitute Malick Fofana and he is replaced by Afonso Moreira (Lyon).
77' The game has come to an end for Tyler Morton. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
73' The referee signals a substitution. Morgan Sanson (Nice) is brought on as a substitute for Sofiane Diop.
73' That will be all from Jeremie Boga who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Tiago Gouveia (Nice).
73' Franck Haise has decided to make a change. Tom Louchet (Nice) replaces Mohamed-Ali Cho.
71' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
68' It is time for a substitution. Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is on for Abner Vinicius.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adam Karabec leaves the pitch and Rachid Ghezzal (Lyon) comes on.
66' Franck Haise decides to make a substitution. Dante will be replaced by Juma Bah (Nice).
66' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
65' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' Jerome Brisard rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Charles Vanhoutte (Nice).
63' A promising first-time strike from inside the box by Tyler Morton (Lyon), but his attempt goes just wide of the target.
58' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
55' 3 - 1 Jonathan Clauss finds Hicham Boudaoui (Nice) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish to make it 3:1.
54' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Adam Karabec (Lyon).
54' Lyon work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) has a great chance to score from the penalty. He shoots to the left post, but Yehvann Diouf leaps out to thwart his attempt.
53' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is going to take the penalty!
51' Charles Vanhoutte (Nice) handles the ball inside the box. A penalty is awarded to Lyon!
49' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
46' The whistle blows and Jerome Brisard starts the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
45+2' Adam Karabec (Lyon) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
45+1' Abner Vinicius (Lyon) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
43' Lyon force a corner. They send men into the box.
43' Malick Fofana (Lyon) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
37' Adam Karabec (Lyon) leans back and sends a volley soaring over the bar from inside the box.
35' 2 - 1 GOAL! Jeremie Boga meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Sofiane Diop (Nice) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:1.
33' The Nice players are stunned as referee Jerome Brisard changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
32' Celebrations by Nice are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
31' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) brings an opponent down and Jerome Brisard interrupts the game. Nice are awarded a penalty! What an opportunity to score.
29' 1 - 1 Goal! Ruben Kluivert gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Pavel Sulc (Lyon) glances a header into the net. 1:1.
29' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Lyon.
26' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
24' Pavel Sulc (Lyon) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
23' Tyler Morton (Lyon) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
22' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Martin Satriano (Lyon) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
19' The ball goes out of play. Lyon are awarded a corner kick.
15' Sofiane Diop (Nice) is adjudged offside.
15' Jonathan Clauss (Nice) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
13' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
12' Tyler Morton (Lyon) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
12' Lyon have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

12' The free kick is delivered by Tyler Morton (Lyon) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared. Lyon have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
11' Tyler Morton (Lyon) launches a cross from the corner, but Yehvann Diouf is alert to thwart the effort.
11' Adam Karabec (Lyon) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent. It will be a corner kick for Lyon.
7' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
5' 1 - 0 What a goal! Sofiane Diop plays it to Melvin Bard (Nice), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Dominik Greif into the left side of the goal. 1:0.
1' Malick Fofana (Lyon) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Lyon will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard will supervise the game today.
